summary: Payroll AC-12 in-memory storage seam reference adapter records trial-close audit, accounting dispatch, and HR leave-impact intake metadata with idempotency validation while explicitly avoiding durable storage, Postgres/RLS, payroll calculation, filing/disbursement rails, Workflow dispatch, HR/accounting calls, and audit-chain emission claims.

findings: The adapter is a compact BTreeMap/BTreeSet reference implementation with no provider configuration or hidden I/O.
Malformed idempotency keys and duplicate writes fail deterministically before records are inserted.
The storage port separates payroll metadata record semantics from future durable Postgres/RLS or cloud provider adapters.

Capability flags keep durable backend, Postgres/RLS, payroll calculation, statutory filing rails, disbursement rails, Workflow dispatch, HR/accounting calls, and audit emission false until real integrations land.

F3_adversarial.failing_fixture_id: duplicate idempotency and malformed key tests
F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Tests fail if duplicate writes are accepted, malformed keys reserve, payroll envelope metadata is dropped, or capability flags imply durable storage/calculation/filing/disbursement/runtime execution.
findings: Positive coverage persists all three payroll record kinds; negative coverage refuses duplicate idempotency keys and unsafe key shapes.
The crate exposes a named storage port trait, in-memory store, stored-record shape, capability descriptor, and explicit persist helpers for each existing Payroll app envelope.
Payroll storage adapter tests/clippy, payroll package-group tests/clippy, 20-package enterprise regression tests/clippy, fmt, data_class scan, and quality-marker scan passed.

alternatives_named: store full payroll/payee/wage-ledger details in the reference adapter
add an in-memory payroll metadata storage seam reference first
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The in-memory reference pins idempotency and payroll envelope-to-record contracts before durable storage, RLS, cloud operations, calculation, and filing/disbursement rails exist.
rejected_reasons: Postgres/RLS requires migrations, tenancy controls, rollback, and SLO evidence that are outside this slice.
Storing full payroll/payee/wage-ledger details would overclaim privacy/security posture; this adapter records metadata only.

findings: No secrets, provider credentials, databases, or network clients are introduced.
Idempotency key validation rejects empty, whitespace, path traversal, and duplicate keys; payroll calculation, filing, disbursement, HR calls, and accounting calls remain false capabilities.

F8_performance.regression_baseline: No durable backend exists; tests exercise fixed-size in-memory metadata records.

findings.summary: Operations are bounded by BTreeMap/BTreeSet key operations over in-process metadata; no network, filesystem, or database I/O is introduced.

findings: Stored-record and capability public fields carry data_class annotations.

Capability response explicitly marks durable backend, Postgres/RLS, payroll calculation, statutory filing rails, disbursement rails, Workflow dispatch, HR/accounting network calls, and audit-chain emission false.
The change is additive: one Payroll in-memory adapter crate, catalog row, workspace membership, spec/tasks/evidence updates, and no migrations or external resources.
Stored records carry topic, tenant, legal entity, run id, primary ref, idempotency key, schema version, payload data class, evidence count, and backend label for future audit/telemetry labels.

Payroll AC-12 and D-11 record the storage seam while durable storage, Postgres/RLS, payroll calculation, filing/disbursement rails, Workflow dispatch, HR/accounting calls, and cloud/SLO evidence remain future slices.

M1_challenge_assumption.premise_stated: A storage seam reference can land before durable Payroll storage if it is explicitly volatile, metadata-only, and all provider/runtime capabilities stay false.
M1_challenge_assumption.premise_evidence_ref: specs/microservices/payroll.json AC-12 and Payroll storage capability tests
M1_challenge_assumption.do_nothing_consequence: Future durable Payroll adapters would lack a tested idempotency and metadata record-shape contract for trial-close audit, accounting dispatch, and HR leave-impact intake envelopes.
M1_challenge_assumption.upstream_fix_rejection_reason: Shared storage providers do not define payroll-specific metadata repository semantics or calculation/filing/disbursement non-claims.

findings: This advances Payroll toward later Oyatie cloud integration without pretending a durable payroll datastore, calculation engine, filing/disbursement rails, Workflow dispatch, HR network integration, or Accounting network integration exists.
Names follow Payroll run storage adapter, in-memory, idempotency, and metadata record vocabulary.

No third-party dependencies were added; the crate depends only on existing Payroll app/domain crates.
